name: Cybersecurity Complaint Triage
shortDescription: A concept for prioritising cybersecurity complaints and identifying potentially fake or low-priority reports.
overview: A hackathon concept focused on helping teams organise incoming cybersecurity complaints so that important reports can receive attention first.
objectives: Explore ways to flag potentially fake or irrelevant reports.
Improve the organisation of incoming reports.
results: Concept developed during the IBM Bob Hackathon.
